args.query: The sum of absolute values of the coefficients of an integer multivariate polynomial

items.name: MvPolynomial.coeff
items.type: {R : Type u} → {σ : Type u_1} → [inst : CommSemiring R] → (σ →₀ ℕ) → MvPolynomial σ R → R

items.name: Polynomial.mahlerMeasure_le_sum_norm_coeff
items.type: ∀ (p : Polynomial ℂ), p.mahlerMeasure ≤ p.sum fun x a => ‖a‖

items.name: MvPolynomial.eval_eq
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (X : σ → R) (f : MvPolynomial σ R),
  (MvPolynomial.eval X) f = ∑ d ∈ f.support, MvPolynomial.coeff d f * ∏ i ∈ d.support, X i ^ d i

items.name: MvPolynomial.coeffs
items.type: {R : Type u} → {σ : Type u_1} → [inst : CommSemiring R] → MvPolynomial σ R → Finset R

items.name: MvPolynomial.totalDegree_monomial
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (s : σ →₀ ℕ) {c : R},
  c ≠ 0 → ((MvPolynomial.monomial s) c).totalDegree = s.sum fun x e => e

items.name: MvPolynomial.support_sum_monomial_coeff
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (p : MvPolynomial σ R),
  ∑ v ∈ p.support, (MvPolynomial.monomial v) (MvPolynomial.coeff v p) = p
